defs.def: a thick liquid that is eaten with food to add flavour to it 调味汁；酱

ex.s: The barbecue gives it that famous smoky flavour and it comes with a shiny sauce that's very, very spicy!
ex.t: 烧烤赋予了它那著名的烟熏风味，再配上一种色泽发亮、非常非常辣的酱汁！

ex.s: It was served cold and came with some sort of sticky sauce which tasted bitter and smelt really fishy!
ex.t: 它是冷着的，配了一种黏糊糊的酱汁，尝起来发苦，闻起来鱼腥味极重！

ex.s: We had the famous "poutine", which is a dish of French fries, fresh cheese and a hot brown sauce called "gravy".
ex.t: 我们有着名的「普丁」，这是一道由薯条、新鲜奶酪和热棕色酱汁组成的菜肴，名为「肉汁」。

ex.s: Local festival food: five-coloured sticky rice, duck in lemon sauce, ...
ex.t: 当地节日美食：五彩糯米饭、柠檬酱鸭……

ex.s: For example, America’s most popular Chinese dish is General Tso’s chicken, which consists of fried chicken covered in a sweet sauce, flavoured with hot red peppers.
ex.t: 例如，美国最受欢迎的中国菜左宗棠鸡，由炸鸡裹在甜酱中并加了红辣椒调味而成。

defs.def: talk or behaviour that is annoying or lacking in respect 讨厌的话（或举动）；无礼的话（或举动）
